crossRefs.note: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce…
Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed…
But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
“After all that has come on us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less…
shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be…
Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

people.name: Peor
people.line: A mountain in Moab associated with idolatry

translations.web: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,
translations.bsb: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day? It even brought a plague upon the congregation of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,
translations.asv: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves unto this day, although there came a plague upon the congregation of Jehovah,
